method: Every listed raw frame personally inspected; individual SHA-256 retained after raw cleanup. Contact sheets only for presentation, no pixel manipulation.
observation: Personally inspected all24 fresh WebGPU/WebGL2 low/high opening, +0.5s and inspection-control frames. Actual game camera shows yellow-green ambush infected entering lower-left sidewalk by +0.5s; controlled close pose confirms the actor. Native source counts3x8, 24 admitted in all tier/policy runs; pairwise opening directions83.1375°,94.3845°,177.5219°. All eight actual follow-camera half-second strips contain projected body bounds; screenshot evidence supplies pixels, not bounds alone.
